episodes.synopsis: Rein is unceremoniously kicked out of the Beast's Fangs, so he decides to become an adventurer.
episodes.title: Everyone Knows What It's Like When Nothing Goes Right, but What Do I Do When That Happens? Why, It's Obvious! I Run and Scream My Head Off!

episodes.synopsis: With help from legendary adventurer Lily Flambert, Rein defeats a mid-level dragon.
episodes.title: The Enhanced Clothes I Was Wearing Were Destroyed by a Devastating Blow, and a Traumatized Girl in Casual Clothes Hit Me With All Her Might.

episodes.synopsis: When Rein and Lily return to town, they meet Margaret, whose sister once adventured with Lily.
episodes.title: When I Went to Apologize With a Friend Who Was a Shut-In for Two Years, We Were Unexpectedly Served Apple Bunnies, so I Think She’s Been Forgiven.

episodes.synopsis: Rein's old guild learns he dispelled their enchantments, and Cornelius hires an assassin.
episodes.title: There’s Something I’ve Learned From Ending Up Naked Twice... When You’re Naked, You Get Bitten Twice.
